de.abas.jfop.base.event

Class Event

  • Object
    • Event

  • public final class Event
extends Object
    Representation of the FO event state.

    Warning:
    DO NEVER store an object of this type in a instance or static variable and try to access it later on. The JVM does not know that this event is no longer in sync with the ERP server side of the FO.
